list.title: Email templates
list.subtitle: Reusable emails with a subject, formatted text and variables. Insert one into a reply from the email composer.
list.empty: Write an email once, with variables such as the contact's first name, and reuse it in any email conversation.
list.emptyFiltered: Try a different search or clear the filters.
list.unavailable: This workspace cannot reach the email templates service right now.
list.noPermission: You can use the templates your workspace shares and keep your own. Ask an admin if you need to change the shared ones.

toolbar.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, subject or category

card.subject: Subject
card.noSubject: No subject: the reply keeps its own
card.used: {count, plural, =0 {Never used} one {Used once} other {Used # times}}

delete.title: Delete this template?
delete.message: "{name}" will be removed for everyone who can use it. Emails already sent from it are not affected.

editor.name: Name
editor.subject: Subject
editor.subjectHint: Optional. Left empty, a reply keeps its own subject.
editor.bodyPlaceholder: Write the email. Use the variables below to personalise it.

general.label: General
general.hint: Answers and one-to-one mail. Sent like any reply.

marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.hint: Promotional mail. Needs the contact's marketing consent where your workspace requires it, and always carries an unsubscribe link.

shared.label: Everyone in the workspace
shared.hint: A shared template. Only people who manage templates can change it.

mine.label: Only me
mine.hint: A personal template. Nobody else sees it.

editor.variablesHint: Variables are filled from the contact, you and the workspace when the template is used. One that has no value is left as written so you can fix it.

problems.tooLong: This is too long (at most {limit} characters).
problems.subjectLines: The subject must be one line.

preview.title: Preview with sample data
preview.empty: Write the message to see a preview.
preview.failed: The preview could not be updated.
preview.issues: {count, plural, one {This variable has no sample value and stays as written: {list}} other {These variables have no sample value and stay as written: {list}}}
preview.sampleNote: Sample values only. The real values come from the contact when you use the template.

picker.title: Email templates
picker.empty: No templates yet. Create them under Email templates in the CRM menu.
picker.replaceMessage: Using "{name}" replaces the message in the box, and the subject if the template has one.
picker.marketingNote: This is marketing mail: it goes through your consent rules and carries an unsubscribe link.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this template. Their version is loaded; review it and try again.
errors.validation: Some of what you entered is not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.unavailable: Email templates are not available right now.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.planDisabled: Your plan does not include email. Upgrade your plan to use email templates.
errors.nameTaken: You already have a template with this name. Choose a different name.
errors.notEditable: Only people who manage email templates can change a shared template.
errors.archived: This template is archived. Restore it to use it.
